title: Typhoon Rosal keeps strength; 2 areas under Signal No. 2

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two areas remained under Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal (TCWS) No. 2 as Typhoon Rosal maintained its strength while moving over the sea east of Batanes, the state weather bureau reported on Friday.
